about: The pictures a tenant or one of its themes may replace. Composer reads this file from the build: the thumbnail is set per tenant in Game settings, and every other slot is offered in the Assets tab. On release the chosen files are written into `brands`.

slots.title: Thumbnail
slots.prompt: A square game thumbnail for Mòpyon Cascades, 512 × 512 px, shown as the game's tile in an app's lobby, on the showcase and in link previews: [the game's hero and its world in one bold, readable picture, with the game's name Mòpyon Cascades in big playful letters]. Bright, saturated cartoon mobile-game art, thick dark outlines, soft cel shading, light from the top left. Fills the square edge to edge, no rounded corners, no border, no transparent margins.
